request.prompt_preview: CASE FILE Question: Customers in Tunis and Sfax complained yesterday around lunchtime that web pages and apps would not load, even though their phones showed full signal. What was going on? Now: 2026-

response.text: The evidence is fully sufficient: a software upgrade (`CHG-2026-0001`) on `CORE-DNS-01` at 2026-09-02 11:00 caused a core DNS degradation between 12:00 and 14:00. This is confirmed by KPI drops (`query_success_pct` down to 89%), latency spikes (`resolution_ms` up to 120), alarm `ALM-000003` (`DNS_TIMEOUT_RATE`), and external events showing no confounding factors. Consequently, customers throughout the country experienced failures loading web pages and apps despite having full signal.
